run_vtrace_experiment: run the vtrace reinforcement learning experiment with atari environments and distributed training
create_optimizer_for_model: create an Adam optimizer for a PyTorch model with configurable learning rate and beta parameters
compute_policy_gradient_loss: compute the policy gradient loss using vtrace returns with behavior and target policy logits
save_load_checkpoint: save and load learner state checkpoints including model optimizer and scheduler state dicts
step_optimizer_with_grad_clipping: step the optimizer with gradient norm clipping and update the learning rate scheduler
